scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Nirman Shramik Sammaan Yojana (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have a minimum of one‑year regular membership
Benefit is given on renewal of membership each year
To avail the benefit, the worker must add at least 90 days of work experience in the preceding year and pay the registration fee
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,100 per year for the purchase of saree, suits, slippers, raincoat, umbrella, sanitary napkins and kitchen utensils.
